You may swap between firing modes at the start of combat or as an action during combat.

Arasaka Prototype Rechargable Battery.name: Arasaka Prototype Rechargable Battery
Arasaka Prototype Rechargable Battery.description:
Required for use by the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_upgrades.Item.8nSzcjNlyulWrZtN]{Arasaka Prototype Railgun Upgrade}.

Each battery contains enough charge to power 8 shots. The battery can be recharged in any power port in 1 hour.
